_policy: Accepted high/critical dependency advisories, checked by scripts/audit-check.mjs.
An entry is a maintainer decision, not a note: everything not listed here fails the
Security workflow. Keep them narrow (one advisory, one package, one tree), give a
reason that names the shipped or reachable path, and set an expiry so the call is
re-made rather than inherited. Past the expiry date the build fails until the entry
is removed or renewed. Expiries are capped at 180 days out and warn 21 days before.
An override in pnpm-workspace.yaml is always the
first choice — an exception is only for a finding no override can fix. Adding one
here when a version bump would do buys a re-decision date instead of a fix.
Trees: "." is the Electron app, the only tree audited.

exceptions.reason: Build-time devDependency only, and not reached in this build: got consults http-cache-semantics only when a cache option is passed, and app-builder-lib 26.15.3 passes none (@electron/get keeps its own file cache). Nothing in the shipped app depends on it (pnpm why --prod). No patched version exists (advisory published 2026-09-18). An override of app-builder-lib>@electron/get to ^5.1.0 removes the package, and a Linux electron-builder dir build still succeeds with it, but @electron/get 5 downloads with fetch, so app-builder-lib's proxy agent and request timeout stop applying. That is unverified for Windows and macOS packaging and for a cold or proxied Electron download, so the exception is preferred until a full packaging run on all three platforms backs the override, as with the earlier app-builder-lib exception. electron-builder 27 also clears it once it leaves alpha.

Developer CLI devDependency only: developers run shadcn by hand to add UI component source, no build, test or CI script runs it, and nothing in the shipped app depends on braces (pnpm why --prod). The denial of service needs an attacker-supplied, deeply nested glob pattern; shadcn's patterns come from its own code, this repo's config, and paths the developer types on its command line. No patched version exists (advisory published 2026-09-18), and braces 3.0.3 is its latest release, so no override can clear it.
